items.detail: The **S&P 500** slipped about **0.3%** on the week to 7,722.72, while the Nasdaq gained about 0.5% as Friday's rally erased most of Monday's selloff.
items.why: Trump's rejection of Iran's ceasefire plan lifted oil early, then a weak jobs report cut Fed hike bets.

items.detail: Odds of an October Fed hike fell from about **71%** on Monday to the **mid-teens** by Friday.
items.why: Cooler core PCE inflation and only 29,000 new jobs in September made another hike look unnecessary.

items.detail: The **30-year Treasury yield** hit its highest level since 2002 midweek and the 10-year touched **5.344%**, capping stock rallies until Friday.
items.why: Inflation fears from oil and heavy corporate bond issuance kept pressure on long-dated government debt.

items.detail: Emerging markets had a rough week, with Korea's Kospi sinking **2.6%** Monday and Hong Kong's **Hang Seng** falling 2.48% Friday as each reopened from holidays.
items.why: Brent swinging above $100 on the US-Iran standoff lifted global yields, which hurts oil-importing economies most.

items.detail: India's **Nifty 50** fell about **3%** over a holiday-shortened week to 22,421.95, ending on four straight losses.
items.why: Foreign funds pulled over ₹26,000 crore in three sessions amid high oil and fears of an RBI hike October 7.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** ended the week near 2,833, down about **0.3%**, as gains on Thursday and Friday recovered most of a midweek slide.
items.why: Falling yields and fading Fed hike odds eased borrowing costs, which matter most for debt-heavy small companies.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** rebounded from a Monday low of $82,630 to top **$85,000** on Friday, ending the week near the top of its range.
items.why: Bitcoin ETFs swung back to inflows and short sellers closed bets as the jobs miss cut hike odds.

items.detail: **Ether** spent the week in a narrow band below its $2,800 ceiling, ending near **$2,690**, barely above Monday's low.
items.why: Record-high long yields and ether fund outflows kept buyers cautious, and leveraged bets fell to their lowest since March.

items.detail: **Solana** dipped below $120 midweek on profit-taking, then recovered to about **$122** by Friday, roughly where it began the week.
items.why: Forced short liquidations and record weekly Solana ETF inflows offset early-October fund outflows.

items.detail: **Spot gold** plunged to $4,111 on Monday, its lowest since August 5, then recovered to about **$4,217** by Friday.
items.why: Oil-driven hike bets lifted yields early, then the weak jobs report cut hike odds and sank the dollar.

crossCuttingTheme: The US-Iran standoff kept Brent above $100 and long yields at 2002 highs, until cooler inflation and a weak jobs report cut Fed hike odds and lifted nearly every market on Friday.
